title: Normalized etale exceptional comparison preserves projection mates
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum of [sk-def-purity-conv], with $A=A_{E,n}$, the bounded constructible finite-Tor pro-etale categories and operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the constructible exceptional inverse images of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For a separated finite-type morphism $h:S\to T$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $K\in D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$ and a tensor-invertible $N\in D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$ [pur9-cs-def-invertible] with a chosen inverse $N'$ and evaluation $N\otimes^LN'\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T$, let $$\kappa_{h,K,N}:Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N\longrightarrow Rh^!(K\otimes^LN)$$ be the morphism corresponding, under the adjunction bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_T(Rh_!P,Q)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_S(P,Rh^!Q)$ of $Rh_!\dashv Rh^!$ used in [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition], to the composite $$Rh_!(Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N)\cong\bigl(Rh_!(Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N)\otimes^LN'\bigr)\otimes^LN\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_{h,Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N,N'}\otimes1}Rh_!(Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N\otimes^LLh^*N')\otimes^LN\cong Rh_!Rh^!K\otimes^LN\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{h,K}\otimes1}K\otimes^LN,$$ where $\operatorname{PF}$ is the specified projection transformation of [def-exchange-projection], $\varepsilon_h$ is the counit, and the unlabelled isomorphisms are the evaluation, the tensor associators and unit constraints, and $Lh^*N\otimes^LLh^*N'\cong Lh^*(N\otimes^LN')\cong A_S$ through the tensor-pullback comparison $\mu_h$ of [def-exchange-projection]. (It does not depend on the choice of $(N',\text{evaluation})$; it is the conjugate of $\operatorname{PF}_{h,(-),N'}$ under $Rh_!\dashv Rh^!$ and $(-)\otimes^LN'\dashv(-)\otimes^LN$, and when $h$ is a closed immersion its inverse is the co-projection isomorphism of [lem-pur-coprojection].) Now let $e:U\to X$ be an etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $\rho_e:Re^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Le^*$ be the normalized natural comparison of [lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization], and let $\mu_{e;M,N}:Le^*(M\otimes^LN)\xrightarrow{\sim}Le^*M\otimes^LLe^*N$ be the tensor-pullback comparison of [def-exchange-projection]. Then for $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and tensor-invertible $N\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$: $$\rho_{e,K\otimes^LN}\circ\kappa_{e,K,N}=\mu_{e;K,N}^{-1}\circ(\rho_{e,K}\otimes1):Re^!K\otimes^LLe^*N\longrightarrow Le^*(K\otimes^LN).$$ In particular $\kappa_{e,K,N}$ is invertible, and with $\operatorname{coProj}_{e,K,N}:=\kappa_{e,K,N}^{-1}$ one has $\mu_{e;K,N}\circ\rho_{e,K\otimes^LN}=(\rho_{e,K}\otimes1)\circ\operatorname{coProj}_{e,K,N}$.
